data.name: Melchior
data.gender_notes: Melchior is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Magi, also known as the Three Wise Men, were led by a star to the birthplace of Jesus. Melchior was one of the Magi and is said to have been the king and leader of this group. His name means 'king of kings'. The name Melchior carries the meaning “King of Kings” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Melchior usually hope their child will grow to embody king of kings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the wisdom and reverence of the Magi, who recognized and honored the newborn King of Kings.
data.etymology: Melchior belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Kings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Melchior total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: מלכיאור
in_hebrew.meaning: מלך אור הוא מלך חכמה וגדולה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מלכיאור הוא אחד משמותיו של אחד מהחכמים שעלו לרגל לירושלים לראות את ישוע התינוק, לפי המסורת הנוצרית. השם מורכב מ'מלך' ו'אור', ומשמעותו הוא מלך האור, או מלך החכמה והגדולה. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים, ויש לו חשיבות רבה במסורת הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Μελχιώρ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Μέλχιωρ είναι ένας από τους τρεις Μάγους που επισκέφθηκαν το νεογέννητο Ιησού Χριστό, σύμφωνα με την παράδοση της Εκκλησίας. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τα εβραϊκά και σημαίνει 'Βασιλιάς του φωτός' ή 'ο Μέγας Βασιλιάς'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη δεν αναφέρεται το όνομα του Μάγου, αλλά η παράδοση την έχει ονομάσει Μέλχιωρ. Ο Μέλχιωρ θεωρείται προστάτης των Χριστιανών και έχει μεγάλη σημασία στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Melchior
in_latin.long_meaning: Melchior est unus ex tribus Magis qui visitarunt Jesum Christum recens natum, secundum traditionem Ecclesiae. Nomen derivatur ex hebraeis et significat 'Rex lucis' vel 'Magnus Rex'. In Novo Testamento nomen Magi non refertur, sed traditio Ecclesiae ei nomen Melchior dedit. Melchior habetur patronus Christianorum et magnam habet significationem in traditione Ecclesiae.

in_english.name: Melchior
in_english.meaning: King of Light, Wise and Powerful Ruler
in_english.long_meaning: Melchior is one of the three wise men who visited the newborn Jesus Christ, according to Christian tradition. The name originates from Hebrew and means 'King of Light' or 'Wise and Powerful Ruler'. In the New Testament, the name of the wise man is not mentioned, but Christian tradition has named him Melchior. He is considered a patron of Christians and holds great significance in Christian tradition, symbolizing wisdom, power, and spiritual guidance.

celebrity_usage: Melchior the Magi, in various Christmas stories
data.cultural_impact: The name Melchior holds a significant place in Christmas folklore as one of the Three Wise Men. According to the biblical account, the Magi followed a star to the birthplace of Jesus in Bethlehem and presented Him with gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh. Melchior is believed to have been the leader of the Magi, as evidenced by his royal title. The name Melchior is still used in various Western European countries, especially in Portugal and Spain, as a given name.
data.spiritual_significance: Melchior's name symbolizes the recognition of Jesus as the King of kings and the land of the Magi, who came from the East, representing the diversity and universality of the Christian faith. It also serves as a reminder of the wise men's reverence and obedience to God, demonstrated by their long journey to pay homage to the birth of Christ. The name Melchior inspires us to seek wisdom, knowledge, and spiritual truth, and to honor and acknowledge the divine presence in our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Melchior is traditionally identified as one of the three Magi, or Wise Men, who visited the baby Jesus. He is believed to represent the wisdom and knowledge brought by the Magi to the newborn king. Melchor's name may also symbolize the guidance and enlightenment that comes from seeking the truth and following the stars.

biblical_reference.note: The name Melchior is not mentioned in the Bible, but it is associated with one of the Magi who visited Jesus.
